2.

This application under Section 529 BNSS has been filed seeking direction to the court below for expeditious disposal of Case No.101 of 2023 arising out of Case Crime No.0224 of 2021, under Sections 498A, 323, 313, 308, 379, 504, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P.Act, Police Station Sujanganj District Jaunpur pending in the court of Additional Civil Judge (Junior Division) 1st Jaunpur within a shortest span of time as fixed by this Court.

sentences.text: Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this application is finally disposed of with a direction to the court concerned to decide the aforesaid case, as expeditiously as possible, without granting any unnecessary or long adjournments to either of the parties, from the date of production of a certified copy of this order, if there is no other legal impediment.
